fields.title: Event / calendar record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of Luma's own internal API JSON shape. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). "event" mode records carry the full upstream event object verbatim (event, calendar, hosts, ticket_info, geo_address_info, etc). "calendar" mode emits one CALENDAR_PROFILE record plus one CALENDAR_EVENT record per event (recordType discriminates). "discover" mode records carry the upstream discover-feed entry verbatim.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The URL/slug that produced this record (or a geo descriptor / "discover" for discover mode).

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-api, or none on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. not_found, kind_mismatch, auth_required).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: "calendar" mode only -- CALENDAR_PROFILE (the organizer's own profile) or CALENDAR_EVENT (one of their events).

event.title: Event
event.description: Event mode -- name, start_at/end_at, timezone, location_type, geo_address_info, cover_url, passed through as-is.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Organizer profile -- name, slug, social handles, verified_at, passed through as-is.

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.description: Event mode -- list of host user objects, passed through as-is.

ticket_info.title: Ticket info
ticket_info.description: Event mode -- price, is_free, spots_remaining, require_approval, passed through as-is.

featured_items.title: Featured items
featured_items.description: CALENDAR_PROFILE record -- upcoming events the organizer has featured on their calendar page.

has_more.title: Has more
has_more.description: Discover/calendar pagination internals -- not normally present on emitted records (consumed internally to drive pagination).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across event / calendar / discover records.
